title: Bag of Bricks Light Nougat-02
descriptionHtml:
Light Nougat — colour 02

The lightest skin tone in the palette. Light Nougat carries the highlights on a face — forehead, cheekbones, the bridge of the nose — and is what stops a portrait looking flat. Most face builds need more of it than you'd expect.

Works well with: Nougat 32, Beige 09, Caramel 15

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Light Nougat bricks (colour 02) for Memobrick mosaics. A soft skin tone that brings warmth and realism to portrait faces. Resealable bag.
